entities.name: Vadax Gor
entities.description: A scarred Rakdos criminal arrested by the Azorius for kidnapping.

entities.name: Parisha
entities.description: Azorius arrester who trailed and caught Vadax Gor.

entities.name: Fblthp
entities.description: A homunculus used as bait and snatched by Vadax Gor.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: Ravnican guild whose arresters and agents caught Vadax Gor.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: Guild of which Vadax Gor was a part.

events.summary: Vadax Gor causes the disappearance of two citizens, putting Parisha on his trail.
events.quote: he caused the disappearance of two citizens

events.summary: Fblthp visits the leatherworker's shop as a ploy by Parisha; the leatherworker sends thugs to look for trouble.
events.quote: One day, a homunculus named Fblthp showed up at the shop

events.summary: Vadax Gor snatches Fblthp in the alley but is caught by Parisha, who locks him with an arrester's ring.
events.quote: he was caught up by Parisha, who threw an arrester's ring on him

relations.quote: Vadax Gor was trapped, and Parisha claimed Fblthp from his arms and locked the criminal up.
Vadax Gor is a Rakdos criminal
